_note: GTO-approximate preflop frequencies for 6-max No-Limit Hold'em. Each hand maps to [raise_freq, call_freq, fold_freq] that must sum to 1.0. Edit any value freely — changes take effect next time the bot loads. Hands omitted from a section default to [0,0,1] (fold).

_sections.open: No previous raises — first to act or steal opportunity
_sections.vs_open: Facing exactly one raise — 3-bet, call, or fold
_sections.vs_3bet: Facing a 3-bet after we opened — 4-bet, call, or fold

vs_open._note: Facing one open raise. raise=3-bet, call=flat, fold=fold.

vs_3bet._note: Facing a 3-bet after we opened. raise=4-bet shove, call=flat, fold=fold.
